description: Frozen rows at the top and bottom of the Svelte 5 data grid, built from three stacked grids. A top grid holds an Account totals row with sum, average and count over the whole dataset, the middle grid scrolls the data, and a bottom grid shows Page totals recomputed from api.getDisplayedRows() as filters change. All three share the column schema and widths, and a right-click pins any data row with a badge.

faq.question: How do the three grids stay aligned?
faq.answer: They receive the same columns array, so widths, alignment and formats match; the top and bottom grids have one row each and no scrollbar, the middle one scrolls.

faq.question: How do the page totals react to filters?
faq.answer: onFiltersChange reads api.getDisplayedRows() from the main grid and recomputes the bottom row from those rows, so totals always describe what is visible.

faq.question: Is there a built-in way?
faq.answer: Yes. The pinnedTopRows and pinnedBottomRows props render pinned rows inside one grid with sticky cells; this stacked version is the option when you need fully independent grids.
